projects.title: Filipino Child Mid-Study Report editorial development
projects.summary: Prepare an editorial review and development plan, edit a study report and create an abridged version, preserving completed technical findings. This test scopes the request without obtaining or editing the manuscript.

requirements.text: Review report structure, narrative coherence and chapter transitions.
Prepare an editorial review and publication-development plan.
Improve readability, terminology and policy messaging in the main manuscript.
Develop an abridged manuscript presenting the main findings and implications.
Preserve technical findings without conducting new statistical analysis.
Incorporate partner comments and deliver editable Word manuscripts.

exclusions: No manuscript retrieval, substantive editing, new analysis or validation of technical findings.
No Word-file production, publication design, meetings, partner contact or approval.
Only proposed scoping artifacts; the customer engagement is not executed.

projects.title: Population and Situational Analysis guide revision
projects.summary: Complete a methodological guide from a revised outline and partial revisions, with an inception report, workplan, initial draft and final version. This test scopes revision work and missing-input dependencies only.

requirements.text: Identify remaining revisions from the revised outline and partially revised guide.
Deliver an inception report and revision workplan.
Generate or obtain missing drafts with the Reference Group.
Develop case studies and update reference links.
Coordinate figures, tables and proposed production design with specialists.
Deliver initial and final guide versions with consistent narrative and analytical approach.

exclusions: No obtaining drafts, source retrieval, link validation or invention of case-study evidence.
No guide authorship, specialist hiring, production meetings or publication design.
Only proposed scoping artifacts; the customer engagement is not executed.

projects.title: Humanitarian-data guidelines editorial outline
projects.summary: Update humanitarian-data guidance through an agreed outline, contributor synthesis and successive drafts, with editorial records and publication coordination. This test scopes the outline and draft dependencies only.

requirements.text: Review and revise the proposed document outline.
Synthesize technical contributions from staff and external specialists.
Develop successive drafts of guidelines and technical reference materials.
Record contributions, document versions and editorial decisions.
Convene an editorial committee and coordinate design and printing.

exclusions: No expert-input retrieval, substantive technical validation or generation of finished guidelines.
No committee meetings, approvals, designer or printer coordination, or publication production.
Only proposed scoping artifacts; the customer engagement is not executed.

projects.title: Data management and monitoring-process inception note
projects.summary: Prepare an inception note, assess data and monitoring processes, propose improvements and practical templates, and deliver a roadmap. This test scopes the inception note without diagnosing organizational systems.

requirements.text: Prepare an inception note and workplan covering methodology, consultations, outputs and timeline.
Map data sources, collection processes, repositories and reporting requirements.
Assess gaps and risks in data quality, inclusion, governance and confidentiality.
Propose improved processes, responsibilities, standards and quality assurance.
Draft practical templates, indicator sheets, reporting guidance and procedures.
Deliver a final report and implementation roadmap following consultations.

exclusions: No live-system inspection, internal-data collection, diagnosis or resource calculations.
No consultations, workshops, travel, tool selection or implementation of recommendations.
Only proposed scoping artifacts; the customer engagement is not executed.

template.unit_definition: One listed requirement per Extract, Classify, or Plan unit; one project scoping report per Report unit. These are not full-project execution units.
template.scope: Public-request scoping only. Do not fetch sources, access private inputs, contact customers, deploy anything, or claim delivery.

operations.instruction: Return an array of objects with exactly requirement_id and evidence. Include each listed requirement once in order. evidence must equal its supplied text exactly.

Return an array of objects with exactly requirement_id, brick, owner. Include every requirement in order and preserve the supplied experimental brick and owner annotations exactly; they are not buyer staffing claims.

Return an array with every requirement in order. Each object has exactly requirement_id, owner, prerequisite_status, review_required, and proposed_artifact. Preserve owner. Set prerequisite_status to unverified and review_required to true. proposed_artifact is a concise, specific proposed scoping artifact (20-300 characters), not completed work or invented findings. Discovering delivery dependencies requires additional authorized inputs.

Return an object with exactly source_url, requirement_ids, exclusions, delivery_status, and summary. Preserve the supplied URL, ordered requirement IDs, and all exclusion strings exactly. delivery_status must be not_executed. summary is a concise scoping summary (40-600 characters) that describes the requested work and missing evidence without inventing outcomes or claiming delivery.
